column1: # Pathways / By credential level. pooled_* is the rung's own ladder, built from its occupations' ladders weighted by employment -- the value V at which a given share of the rung's JOBS pay less than V. published_* is percentiles.json's tier roll-up, the employment-weighted MEAN of those occupations' percentiles, which understates the spread by up to 44% and is NOT what the chart draws.
